<html lang="es-CO">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=5.0">
<title>TROGÜI ROPA — Calzado para toda Colombia | Envío Gratis y Pago Contra Entrega</title>
<meta name="description" content="TROGÜI ROPA: tenis, botas, sandalias, baletas y tacones al mejor precio. Envío gratis a toda Colombia y pago contra entrega.">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 viewBox=%220 0 100 100%22><rect width=%22100%22 height=%22100%22 rx=%2220%22 fill=%22%23ff6a00%22/><text x=%2250%22 y=%2266%22 font-size=%2255%22 font-family=%22Arial%22 font-weight=%22900%22 fill=%22black%22 text-anchor=%22middle%22>T</text></svg>">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://d39ru7awumhhs2.cloudfront.net">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Poppins:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --black:#14140f; --cream:#faf9f6; --white:#fff;
  --orange:#ff6a00; --orange-dark:#e25a00; --orange-light:#ff9a52;
  --green:#1db954; --green-dark:#149042; --whats-green:#25d366;
  --gray:#6b6b63; --gray-light:#e9e7e0; --surface:#f5f4ef;
  --radius:16px; --shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(20,20,15,.10);
  font-size:16px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;}
body{font-family:'Montserrat','Poppins',system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;background:var(--cream);color:var(--black);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden;letter-spacing:.01em;}
img{max-width:100%;display:block;}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:none;}
.icon{width:17px;height:17px;flex:none;display:inline-block;vertical-align:-4px;}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .6s ease,transform .6s ease;}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}

/* MARQUEE TOP BAR */
.top-bar{background:var(--black);color:#fff;padding:7px 0;overflow:hidden;}
.top-bar-track{display:flex;gap:46px;white-space:nowrap;width:max-content;animation:tickerScroll 20s linear infinite;}
@keyframes tickerScroll{0%{transform:translateX(0);}100%{transform:translateX(-50%);}}
.top-bar-track span{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#f0e9e0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.top-bar-track span b{color:var(--orange-light);}

/* HEADER */
header.site-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:90;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-light);box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.04);}
.header-inner{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:10px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;}
.logo-box{background:var(--orange);border-radius:10px;padding:6px 12px;position:relative;flex:none;overflow:hidden;}
.logo-main{font-weight:900;font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--black);letter-spacing:.01em;line-height:1;}
.logo-stamp{position:absolute;right:4px;bottom:-2px;font-weight:900;font-style:italic;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--black);transform:rotate(14deg);opacity:.88;font-family:Georgia,serif;}
.menu-btn{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--black);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none;}
.header-spacer{flex:1;}
.icon-btn{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--black);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none;position:relative;}
.cart-badge{position:absolute;top:-5px;right:-5px;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-size:.62rem;font-weight:800;min-width:17px;height:17px;border-radius:999px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 3px;}
.btn-catalogo{border:1.5px solid var(--black);color:var(--black);font-weight:700;font-size:.74rem;padding:8px 13px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap;flex:none;}
.search-row{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px 10px;}
.search-wrap{position:relative;}
.search-wrap input{width:100%;padding:10px 42px 10px 15px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid var(--gray-light);font-size:.88rem;outline:none;background:var(--surface);}
.search-wrap input:focus{border-color:var(--orange);}
.search-wrap button{position:absolute;right:3px;top:3px;bottom:3px;width:36px;background:var(--orange);border-radius:999px;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}

/* DRAWER */
.drawer-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,10,7,.5);z-index:150;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s;}
.drawer-overlay.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;}
.drawer{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;bottom:0;width:80%;max-width:300px;background:#fff;z-index:151;transform:translateX(-105%);transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1);display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.drawer.open{transform:translateX(0);}
.drawer-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-light);}
.drawer-close{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.drawer-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:10px 0 20px;}
.drawer-label{font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--gray);text-transform:uppercase;padding:14px 18px 6px;}
.drawer-cat-item{display:flex;align-items:center;width:100%;padding:11px 18px;font-weight:600;font-size:.88rem;border-left:3px solid transparent;color:var(--black);}
.drawer-cat-item.active{background:#fff3e9;border-left-color:var(--orange);color:var(--orange-dark);}
.drawer-link{display:block;padding:10px 18px;color:var(--gray);font-size:.84rem;}
.drawer-wsp{margin:14px 18px 0;background:var(--whats-green);color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;padding:12px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;}

/* HERO */
.hero{max-width:1280px;margin:14px auto 0;padding:0 16px;}
.hero-banner{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--black) 55%,var(--orange-dark) 140%);border-radius:20px;padding:30px 26px;color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
.hero-banner::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-70px;right:-70px;width:240px;height:240px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,106,0,.3),transparent 70%);animation:floatA 6s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes floatA{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);}50%{transform:scale(1.18);}}
.hero-banner h1{font-size:clamp(1.3rem,3.6vw,2.1rem);font-weight:800;margin:0 0 8px;position:relative;z-index:2;}
.hero-banner p{margin:0 0 16px;color:#e8e2da;font-size:.9rem;max-width:420px;position:relative;z-index:2;}
.hero-badges{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;position:relative;z-index:2;}
.hero-badge{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}

/* SECTION TITLES */
.section-title{max-width:1280px;margin:24px auto 12px;padding:0 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}
.section-title h2{font-size:1.2rem;margin:0;font-weight:800;}
.section-title span{color:var(--orange-dark);}
.section-sub{color:var(--gray);font-size:.8rem;margin:2px 0 0;}

/* NAV CATEGORIES CHIPS */
.cat-chips{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px;display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;-ms-overflow-style:none;scrollbar-width:none;}
.cat-chips::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
.cat-chip{flex:none;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--gray-light);font-weight:700;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--black);}
.cat-chip.active{background:var(--black);border-color:var(--black);color:#fff;}

/* GRID / CARDS */
.grid{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:14px 16px 40px;display:grid;gap:14px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(165px,1fr));}
.card{background:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--gray-light);display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform .18s,box-shadow .18s;position:relative;}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(20,20,15,.12);}
.card-img-wrap{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1/1;background:var(--surface);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;}
.card-img-wrap img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .35s;}
.card:hover .card-img-wrap img{transform:scale(1.06);}
.badge-off{position:absolute;top:7px;left:7px;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:800;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:6px;}
.badge-cat{position:absolute;top:7px;right:7px;background:rgba(20,20,15,.75);color:#fff;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;}
.card-body{padding:10px 10px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;flex:1;}
.card-title{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.28;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;min-height:2.3em;}
.card-envio{color:#d8291d;font-weight:800;font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase;}
.stars{color:#ffb400;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:1px;}
.stars .count{color:var(--gray);font-size:.66rem;margin-left:3px;letter-spacing:0;}
.price-row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.price-now{color:var(--black);font-weight:800;font-size:1.05rem;}
.price-old{color:#9c9c94;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:.72rem;}
.card-btns{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:2px;}
.card-btns{align-items:stretch;}
.btn-mini{text-align:center;padding:9px 4px;border-radius:8px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;letter-spacing:.03em;}
.btn-mini.buy{flex:2.4;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;text-transform:uppercase;}
.btn-mini.cart{flex:1;background:var(--black);color:#fff;max-width:38px;}
.btn-mini.cart .icon{width:14px;height:14px;}
.btn-mini.buy.shake{animation:shk .6s ease-in-out 2;}
@keyframes shk{0%,84%{transform:scale(1);}87%{transform:scale(1.04) rotate(-1deg);}90%{transform:scale(1.04) rotate(1deg);}93%{transform:scale(1.02);}100%{transform:scale(1);}}

/* TRUST STRIP */
.trust-strip{background:#fff;border-top:1px solid var(--gray-light);padding:20px 14px;margin-top:30px;}
.trust-strip-inner{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;}
@media (max-width:700px){.trust-strip-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
.ts-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;}
.ts-item .icon{width:22px;height:22px;color:var(--orange);}
.ts-item b{display:block;font-size:.8rem;}
.ts-item span{font-size:.68rem;color:var(--gray);}

/* PRODUCT DETAIL */
.detail-wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px 16px 50px;}
.breadcrumb{font-size:.76rem;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:12px;}
.breadcrumb a{color:var(--orange-dark);}
.detail-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:32px;}
@media (max-width:820px){.detail-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px;}}
.gallery-main{aspect-ratio:1/1;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--gray-light);}
.gallery-main img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.detail-title{font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:800;margin:0 0 6px;line-height:1.25;}
.detail-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:10px;}
.detail-price-block{background:#f5f4ef;border:1px dashed var(--black);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:12px;}
.detail-price-row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.detail-price-now{font-size:1.8rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--black);}
.detail-price-old{font-size:1rem;color:#9c9c94;text-decoration:line-through;}
.savings{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--green-dark);font-weight:700;margin-top:4px;}
.select-block{margin-bottom:14px;}
.select-block label{display:block;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:7px;}
.chip-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;}
.sel-chip{padding:8px 13px;border-radius:9px;border:1.5px solid var(--gray-light);font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;background:#fff;}
.sel-chip.active{border-color:var(--orange);background:#fff3e9;color:var(--orange-dark);}
.qty-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:14px 0;}
.qty-box{display:flex;align-items:center;border:1.5px solid var(--gray-light);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;}
.qty-box button{width:34px;height:34px;background:var(--surface);font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:700;}
.qty-box input{width:40px;text-align:center;border:none;font-size:.9rem;}
.cta-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;}
.cta-big{padding:14px;border-radius:12px;font-size:.92rem;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;}
.cta-buy{background:var(--orange);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(255,106,0,.35);animation:shk 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;}
.cta-cart{background:var(--black);color:#fff;}
.trust-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px;margin:14px 0;}
.trust-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--gray-light);border-radius:9px;padding:8px 9px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;}
.trust-item .icon{width:17px;height:17px;color:var(--orange);flex:none;}
.delivery-calc{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--gray-light);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin:12px 0;}
.delivery-calc label{display:block;font-size:.74rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;}
.delivery-calc-row{display:flex;gap:7px;}
.delivery-calc-row input{flex:1;padding:9px 11px;border:1.5px solid var(--gray-light);border-radius:9px;font-size:.8rem;}
.delivery-calc-row button{background:var(--black);color:#fff;padding:0 14px;border-radius:9px;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:700;}
.delivery-result{margin-top:8px;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;display:none;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:7px;}
.delivery-result.show{display:flex;}
.delivery-result.main{background:#e9f9ee;color:#1a8a4a;}
.delivery-result.other{background:#fff4ea;color:var(--orange-dark);}

.desc-block{max-width:1100px;margin:26px auto;padding:0 16px;}
.desc-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--gray-light);border-radius:16px;padding:20px 22px;}
.desc-card h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:1.02rem;}
.desc-card p{font-size:.86rem;line-height:1.6;color:#333;margin:0 0 10px;}

.reviews-block{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto 40px;padding:0 16px;}
.reviews-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:12px;}
.review-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:12px;}
.review-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--gray-light);border-radius:13px;padding:14px;}
.review-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:7px;}
.review-avatar{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.8rem;flex:none;}
.review-name{font-weight:700;font-size:.8rem;}
.review-loc{font-size:.66rem;color:var(--gray);}
.review-text{font-size:.8rem;color:#333;line-height:1.4;}

.related-block{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto 46px;padding:0 16px;}

/* FOOTER */
footer{background:var(--black);color:#d9d9d0;margin-top:30px;padding:34px 16px 90px;}
.footer-inner{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr 1fr;gap:24px;}
@media (max-width:700px){.footer-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
.footer-inner h4{color:#fff;font-size:.86rem;margin:0 0 10px;}
.footer-inner p,.footer-inner a{font-size:.76rem;color:#b9b9b0;line-height:1.65;display:block;}
.foot-logo{font-weight:900;font-size:1.2rem;color:#fff;margin-bottom:6px;}
.foot-logo span{color:var(--orange);}
.carrier-pill{background:#242419;color:#cfcfc6;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid #33332a;display:inline-block;margin:0 4px 4px 0;}
@media (min-width:761px){footer{padding-bottom:34px;}}

/* FLOATING */
.fab-whatsapp{position:fixed;bottom:84px;right:16px;z-index:80;width:54px;height:54px;background:var(--whats-green);border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.3);animation:wpulse 2s infinite;}
@keyframes wpulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(37,211,102,.55);}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 14px rgba(37,211,102,0);}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(37,211,102,0);}}
.mini-fab{position:fixed;bottom:16px;z-index:85;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--black);color:var(--black);font-size:.7rem;font-weight:900;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.18);}
.mini-fab.r{left:12px;}
.mini-fab.p{left:46px;}

/* BOTTOM NAV */
.bottom-nav{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:92;background:#fff;border-top:1px solid var(--gray-light);padding:6px 4px calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));box-shadow:0 -4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.06);}
.bottom-nav-inner{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;justify-content:space-around;}
.bottom-nav-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;color:var(--gray);font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;padding:4px 10px;flex:1;position:relative;}
.bottom-nav-item .icon{width:20px;height:20px;}
.bottom-nav-item.active{color:var(--orange-dark);}

/* MODALS */
.modal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(15,15,10,.55);z-index:200;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px;backdrop-filter:blur(2px);}
.modal{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;max-width:480px;width:100%;max-height:88vh;overflow-y:auto;padding:20px;position:relative;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.35);}
.modal.wide{max-width:760px;}
.modal-close{position:absolute;top:13px;right:13px;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.05rem;color:#333;}
.modal h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:1.08rem;}
.modal .sub{color:var(--gray);font-size:.78rem;margin-bottom:14px;}
.form-row{margin-bottom:11px;}
.form-row label{display:block;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:5px;color:#333;}
.form-row input,.form-row select,.form-row textarea{width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border:1.5px solid var(--gray-light);border-radius:9px;font-size:.86rem;font-family:inherit;outline:none;background:#fff;color:#111;}
.form-row input:focus,.form-row select:focus,.form-row textarea:focus{border-color:var(--orange);}
.radio-group{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.radio-opt{flex:1;min-width:130px;border:1.5px solid var(--gray-light);border-radius:9px;padding:9px 11px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;}
.radio-opt input{width:auto;}
.radio-opt.checked{border-color:var(--orange);background:#fff8f2;}
.modal-submit{width:100%;padding:13px;background:var(--whats-green);color:#fff;font-weight:800;border-radius:11px;font-size:.9rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;margin-top:5px;}
.modal-submit:disabled{opacity:.6;}
.carriers-form-note{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:var(--surface);border-radius:11px;padding:9px 11px;margin-top:12px;}
.carriers-form-note img{width:42px;height:auto;border-radius:6px;flex:none;}
.carriers-form-note span{font-size:.72rem;color:#555;font-weight:600;}
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:150px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--black);color:#fff;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;z-index:300;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.3);opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s;}
.toast.show{opacity:1;}

/* CART MODAL */
.cart-item{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-light);padding:10px 0;}
.cart-item img{width:52px;height:52px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;flex:none;}
.cart-item-info{flex:1;min-width:0;}
.cart-item-info b{display:block;font-size:.78rem;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.cart-item-info small{color:var(--gray);font-size:.68rem;}
.cart-item-price{font-weight:800;color:var(--green-dark);font-size:.82rem;white-space:nowrap;}
.cart-item-del{color:#c0392b;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;margin-top:2px;}
.cart-total-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:14px 0 4px;font-weight:800;font-size:1rem;}
.cart-empty{text-align:center;padding:30px;color:var(--gray);font-size:.85rem;}

/* NOTIFICATIONS */
.notif-host{position:fixed;bottom:146px;left:12px;z-index:85;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;max-width:230px;}
.notif-toast{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--gray-light);border-left:3px solid var(--orange);border-radius:10px;padding:9px 11px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;color:#222;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.14);opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);transition:opacity .3s,transform .3s;}
.notif-toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
.notif-avatar{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:.7rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none;}

/* ADMIN / ORDERS */
.admin-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;max-height:60vh;overflow-y:auto;}
.admin-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid var(--gray-light);border-radius:9px;padding:7px;}
.admin-row img{width:40px;height:40px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:6px;flex:none;}
.admin-row .info{flex:1;min-width:0;}
.admin-row .info b{display:block;font-size:.76rem;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.admin-row .info small{color:var(--gray);font-size:.68rem;}
.admin-row button{background:var(--black);color:#fff;font-size:.66rem;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:6px;font-weight:700;}
.order-card{border:1px solid var(--gray-light);border-radius:11px;padding:11px 13px;margin-bottom:9px;background:#fff;}
.order-card-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px;margin-bottom:7px;}
.order-line{font-size:.78rem;color:#333;margin-bottom:3px;line-height:1.4;}
.order-status{display:inline-block;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:999px;}
.order-status.pendiente{background:#fff4ea;color:var(--orange-dark);}
.order-status.resuelto{background:#e6f3ff;color:#1a5aa8;}
.order-status.entregado{background:#e9f9ee;color:#1a8a4a;}
.order-status.cancelado{background:#fbe9e7;color:#c0392b;}
.order-actions{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-top:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.order-actions button{font-size:.66rem;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:6px;font-weight:700;background:var(--surface);color:#333;}
.order-actions button.active{background:var(--black);color:#fff;}
.orders-summary{display:flex;gap:7px;margin-bottom:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.orders-summary .pill{background:var(--surface);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;color:#333;}
.orders-empty,.empty-state{text-align:center;padding:50px 20px;color:var(--gray);}
.spinner-row{display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:40px;}

@media (max-width:600px){
  .grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px;}
  .detail-price-now{font-size:1.5rem;}
}
body{padding-bottom:64px;}
</style>
</head>

function seededRand(seed){ let x = Math.sin(seed) * 10000; return x - Math.floor(x); }
function hashStr(str){ let h = 0; for(let i=0;i<str.length;i++){ h = (h*31 + str.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0; } return h; }
function buildReviewsFor(product){
  const seedBase = hashStr(product.id + product.name);
  const n = 3 + Math.floor(seededRand(seedBase) * 3);
  const list = []; const usedNames = new Set();
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    let ni = Math.floor(seededRand(seedBase + i*7.13) * NOMBRES_CO.length);
    while(usedNames.has(ni)){ ni = (ni+1) % NOMBRES_CO.length; }
    usedNames.add(ni);
    const ci = Math.floor(seededRand(seedBase + i*3.71) * CIUDADES_CO.length);
    const txi = Math.floor(seededRand(seedBase + i*5.29) * COMENTARIOS_POOL.length);
    const starVal = seededRand(seedBase + i*1.91) > 0.15 ? 5 : 4;
    list.push({name:NOMBRES_CO[ni], city:CIUDADES_CO[ci], text:COMENTARIOS_POOL[txi], stars:starVal});
  }
  return list;
}

function money(n){ return '$' + Math.round(n).toLocaleString('es-CO'); }
function pct(oldP, newP){ return Math.round((1 - (newP/oldP)) * 100); }
function normalizeTxt(s){ return (s||'').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,''); }
function escapeHtml(s){ return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;'); }
function slug(s){ return normalizeTxt(s).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/(^-|-$)/g,''); }
function estimateDelivery(cityText){
  const norm = normalizeTxt(cityText||'').trim();
  if(!norm) return null;
  const isMain = CIUDADES_PRINCIPALES.some(c => norm.includes(c) || c.includes(norm));
  return isMain ? {min:3,max:5,main:true} : {min:3,max:7,main:false};
}
function levenshtein(a,b){
  const m=a.length,n=b.length;
  if(!m) return n; if(!n) return m;
  const dp = Array.from({length:m+1},(_,i)=>[i,...Array(n).fill(0)]);
  for(let j=0;j<=n;j++) dp[0][j]=j;
  for(let i=1;i<=m;i++){
    for(let j=1;j<=n;j++){
      dp[i][j] = a[i-1]===b[j-1] ? dp[i-1][j-1] : 1+Math.min(dp[i-1][j-1],dp[i-1][j],dp[i][j-1]);
    }
  }
  return dp[m][n];
}
function fuzzyIncludes(haystack, needle){
  haystack = normalizeTxt(haystack); needle = normalizeTxt(needle).trim();
  if(!needle) return true;
  if(haystack.includes(needle)) return true;
  const words = haystack.split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter(Boolean);
  const needleWords = needle.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  return needleWords.every(nw=>{
    if(nw.length<3) return haystack.includes(nw);
    return words.some(w=> w.includes(nw) || levenshtein(w,nw) <= (nw.length>=6?2:1));
  });
}
function garantiaDias(id){ return (hashStr(id) % 2 === 0) ? 15 : 30; }

/* ---------- Store overrides (panel R) ---------- */
function readStore(){ try{ const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORE_STORAGE_KEY); return raw? JSON.parse(raw) : {overrides:{}}; }catch(e){ return {overrides:{}}; } }
function writeStore(d){ try{ localStorage.setItem(STORE_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(d)); }catch(e){} }
function getAllProducts(){
  const store = readStore();
  return RAW_PRODUCTS.map(p => store.overrides[p.id] ? {...p, ...store.overrides[p.id]} : p);
}

/* ---------- Carrito ---------- */
function readCart(){ try{ const raw = localStorage.getItem(CART_STORAGE_KEY); return raw? JSON.parse(raw) : []; }catch(e){ return []; } }
function writeCart(c){ try{ localStorage.setItem(CART_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(c)); }catch(e){} updateCartBadge(); }
function updateCartBadge(){
  const cart = readCart();
  const n = cart.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.cantidad,0);
  document.querySelectorAll('.cart-badge').forEach(el=>{ el.textContent = n; el.style.display = n>0 ? 'flex' : 'none'; });
}
function addToCart(id, talla, color, qty){
  qty = qty || 1;
  const p = STATE.products.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(!p) return;
  if(p.sizeMin && !talla){ showToast('Elige una talla'); return false; }
  if(p.colors && p.colors.length>1 && !color){ showToast('Elige un color'); return false; }
  const cart = readCart();
  const key = id + '|' + (talla||'') + '|' + (color||'');
  const existing = cart.find(i=> (i.id+'|'+(i.talla||'')+'|'+(i.color||'')) === key);
  if(existing){ existing.cantidad += qty; }
  else{ cart.push({id, nombre:p.name, precio:p.price, img:p.img, talla:talla||'', color:color||'', cantidad:qty}); }
  writeCart(cart);
  showToast('Agregado al carrito 🛒');
  return true;
}
function removeFromCart(idx){ const cart = readCart(); cart.splice(idx,1); writeCart(cart); renderCartModal(); }
function cartTotal(){ return readCart().reduce((s,i)=>s+i.precio*i.cantidad,0); }

function openCartModal(){
  const overlay = document.createElement('div'); overlay.className='modal-overlay'; overlay.id='cartOverlay';
  overlay.innerHTML = `<div class="modal"><div class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal('cartOverlay')">${ICONS.close}</div>
    <h3>Tu carrito</h3><p class="sub">Revisa tus productos antes de hacer el pedido.</p>
    <div id="cartList"></div>
    <div class="cart-total-row"><span>Total</span><span id="cartTotalLabel">$0</span></div>
    <button class="modal-submit" style="background:var(--orange);" onclick="closeModal('cartOverlay');openOrderModal();">${ICONS.whatsapp}<span>Finalizar pedido</span></button>
  </div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  renderCartModal();
}
function renderCartModal(){
  const cart = readCart();
  const list = document.getElementById('cartList');
  if(!list) return;
  if(!cart.length){ list.innerHTML = '<div class="cart-empty">Tu carrito está vacío.</div>'; }
  else{
    list.innerHTML = cart.map((i,idx)=>`
      <div class="cart-item">
        <img src="${i.img}" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src='${PLACEHOLDER_IMG}';">
        <div class="cart-item-info"><b>${escapeHtml(i.nombre)}</b><small>${i.talla?('Talla '+i.talla+' · '):''}${escapeHtml(i.color||'')} · x${i.cantidad}</small></div>
        <div style="text-align:right;"><div class="cart-item-price">${money(i.precio*i.cantidad)}</div><div class="cart-item-del" onclick="removeFromCart(${idx})">Quitar</div></div>
      </div>`).join('');
  }
  const totalEl = document.getElementById('cartTotalLabel'); if(totalEl) totalEl.textContent = money(cartTotal());
}

/* ---------- Estado / router ---------- */
let STATE = { products: [], order: [], category:'todas', genero:'todos', query:'' };
function shuffle(arr){ const a=[...arr]; for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){ const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)); [a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]; } return a; }
function currentRoute(){
  const hash = location.hash || '#/';
  const m = hash.match(/^#\/producto\/(.+)$/);
  if(m) return {name:'product', id: decodeURIComponent(m[1])};
  return {name:'home'};
}
window.addEventListener('hashchange', render);
const app = document.getElementById('app');

function render(){
  STATE.products = getAllProducts();
  if(!STATE.order.length || STATE.order.length !== STATE.products.length){ STATE.order = shuffle(STATE.products.map(p=>p.id)); }
  const route = currentRoute();
  window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'instant'});
  if(route.name==='product'){
    const product = STATE.products.find(p=>p.id===route.id);
    if(product) renderProductPage(product); else { location.hash='#/'; }
  } else { renderHome(); }
}
function orderedProducts(){
  const byId = Object.fromEntries(STATE.products.map(p=>[p.id,p]));
  let list = STATE.order.map(id=>byId[id]).filter(Boolean);
  if(STATE.category!=='todas') list = list.filter(p=>p.cat===STATE.category);
  if(STATE.genero && STATE.genero!=='todos') list = list.filter(p=>p.genero===STATE.genero);
  if(STATE.query.trim()) list = list.filter(p=> fuzzyIncludes(p.name+' '+(CAT_LABELS[p.cat]||p.cat), STATE.query));
  return list;
}
function setGenero(g){ STATE.genero=g; render(); }
const GENERO_LABELS = {todos:'Todos', dama:'Dama', caballero:'Caballero', ninos:'Niños', unisex:'Unisex'};

    <div class="cat-chips" style="margin-top:7px;">${['todos','dama','caballero','ninos','unisex'].map(g=>`<button class="cat-chip ${STATE.genero===g?'active':''}" onclick="setGenero('${g}')" style="${STATE.genero===g?'':'background:var(--surface);'}">${GENERO_LABELS[g]}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    <div class="section-title"><div>
      <h2>${STATE.category==='todas'?'Todos los <span>productos</span>':(CAT_LABELS[STATE.category]||STATE.category)}</h2>
      <p class="section-sub">${list.length} producto${list.length===1?'':'s'} disponible${list.length===1?'':'s'} · envío gratis a toda Colombia</p>
    </div></div>
    <div class="grid" id="grid">${list.length? list.map(cardHtml).join('') : emptyStateHtml()}</div>
    ${trustStripHtml()}

  `;

function emptyStateHtml(){ return `<div class="empty-state" style="grid-column:1/-1;">${ICONS.search}<p>No encontramos productos con esa búsqueda.</p></div>`; }

function hasRating(id){ return (hashStr(id) % 10) < 6; }
function cardHtml(p){
  const discount = p.oldPrice? pct(p.oldPrice,p.price):0;
  const showRating = hasRating(p.id);
  return `<div class="card" data-pid="${p.id}">
    ${discount>0?`<span class="badge-off">-${discount}%</span>`:''}
    <span class="badge-cat">${CAT_LABELS[p.cat]||p.cat}</span>
    <div class="card-img-wrap" onclick="goToProduct('${p.id}')"><img src="${p.img}" alt="${escapeHtml(p.name)}" loading="lazy" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src='${PLACEHOLDER_IMG}';"></div>
    <div class="card-body">
      <div class="card-title" onclick="goToProduct('${p.id}')">${escapeHtml(p.name)}</div>
      <div class="card-envio">Envío gratis</div>
      ${showRating?`<div class="stars">★★★★★ <span class="count">(${20+ (hashStr(p.id)%180)}+ vendidos)</span></div>`:'<div style="height:.9rem;"></div>'}
      <div class="price-row"><span class="price-now">${money(p.price)}</span>${p.oldPrice?`<span class="price-old">${money(p.oldPrice)}</span>`:''}</div>
      <div class="card-btns">
        <button class="btn-mini buy" id="buy-${p.id}" onclick="goToProduct('${p.id}')">Comprar</button>
        <button class="btn-mini cart" onclick="quickAdd('${p.id}')">${ICONS.cart}</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
function quickAdd(id){
  const p = STATE.products.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(!p) return;
  if((p.sizeMin) || (p.colors&&p.colors.length>1)){ goToProduct(id); return; }
  addToCart(id, null, (p.colors&&p.colors[0])||'', 1);
}
function goToProduct(id){ location.hash = '#/producto/' + encodeURIComponent(id); }
function setCategory(c){ STATE.category=c; render(); }
function doSearch(){ const el=document.getElementById('searchInput'); STATE.query = el?el.value:''; renderHome(); }
function bindGlobalEvents(){
  const input = document.getElementById('searchInput');
  if(input){ input.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{ if(e.key==='Enter') doSearch(); }); input.addEventListener('input', debounce(()=>doSearch(),250)); }
  startIdleShakeWatcher();
}

/* Sacuden el boton "Comprar" de la tarjeta que la persona lleva ~6s mirando sin interactuar */
let IDLE_IO = null;
function startIdleShakeWatcher(){
  if(IDLE_IO) IDLE_IO.disconnect();
  const timers = new Map();
  IDLE_IO = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
    entries.forEach(entry=>{
      const card = entry.target;
      const pid = card.getAttribute('data-pid');
      if(entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0.6){
        if(!timers.has(pid)){
          const t = setTimeout(()=>{
            const btn = document.getElementById('buy-'+pid);
            if(btn){ btn.classList.remove('shake'); void btn.offsetWidth; btn.classList.add('shake'); }
          }, 6000);
          timers.set(pid, t);
        }
      } else {
        if(timers.has(pid)){ clearTimeout(timers.get(pid)); timers.delete(pid); }
      }
    });
  }, {threshold:[0,0.6]});
  document.querySelectorAll('.card[data-pid]').forEach(c=> IDL_OBSERVE(c));
  function IDL_OBSERVE(c){ IDLE_IO.observe(c); }
}
function debounce(fn,wait){ let t; return (...a)=>{ clearTimeout(t); t=setTimeout(()=>fn(...a),wait); }; }

  return `<footer><div class="footer-inner">
    <div><div class="foot-logo">TR<span>O</span>GÜI ROPA</div><p>Calzado y accesorios para toda Colombia. Productos de calidad, pensados para tu día a día.</p>
      <div style="margin-top:8px;"><span class="carrier-pill">Interrapidísimo</span><span class="carrier-pill">Envía</span><span class="carrier-pill">Coordinadora</span></div></div>
    <div><h4>Ayuda</h4><a href="https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}" target="_blank">Contáctanos por WhatsApp</a><a href="${CATALOGO_URL}" target="_blank">Ver catálogo completo</a></div>
    <div><h4>Contacto</h4><a href="https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}" target="_blank">WhatsApp 320 657 2598</a><p>Sede en Bogotá y Cali</p></div>
  </div></footer>`;
}
function fabsHtml(){
  return `<a class="fab-whatsapp" href="https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}?text=${encodeURIComponent('Hola Trogüi Ropa, tengo una pregunta.')}" target="_blank">${ICONS.whatsapp}</a>
  <div class="mini-fab r" onclick="openAdminLogin()">R</div>
  <div class="mini-fab p" onclick="openOrdersLogin()">P</div>
  <div id="notifHost" class="notif-host"></div><div id="toast" class="toast"></div>`;
}
function bottomNavHtml(active){
  return `<nav class="bottom-nav"><div class="bottom-nav-inner">
    <a class="bottom-nav-item ${active==='inicio'?'active':''}" href="#/">${ICONS.home}<span>Inicio</span></a>
    <button class="bottom-nav-item" onclick="openDrawer()">${ICONS.grid}<span>Categorías</span></button>
    <button class="bottom-nav-item" onclick="openCartModal()">${ICONS.cart}<span>Carrito</span></button>
    <a class="bottom-nav-item" href="https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}" target="_blank" style="color:#1a8a4a;">${ICONS.whatsapp}<span>WhatsApp</span></a>
  </div></nav>`;
}

/* ---------- Notificaciones ---------- */
let NOTIF_STARTED=false;
function startNotifications(){
  if(NOTIF_STARTED) return; NOTIF_STARTED=true;
  const loop=()=>{ const delay=15000+Math.random()*12000; setTimeout(()=>{ pushNotif(); loop(); }, delay); };
  setTimeout(()=>pushNotif(), 6000); setTimeout(loop, 18000);
}
function pushNotif(){
  const host=document.getElementById('notifHost'); if(!host||!STATE.products.length) return;
  const name=NOMBRES_CO[Math.floor(Math.random()*NOMBRES_CO.length)];
  const city=CIUDADES_CO[Math.floor(Math.random()*CIUDADES_CO.length)];
  const p=STATE.products[Math.floor(Math.random()*STATE.products.length)];
  const el=document.createElement('div'); el.className='notif-toast';
  el.innerHTML=`<span class="notif-avatar">${name.charAt(0)}</span><span><b>${name}</b> compró ${escapeHtml(p.name.slice(0,22))} en ${city}</span>`;
  host.appendChild(el); requestAnimationFrame(()=>el.classList.add('show'));
  setTimeout(()=>{ el.classList.remove('show'); setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),400); }, 4600);
}
function showToast(msg){ const t=document.getElementById('toast'); if(!t)return; t.textContent=msg; t.classList.add('show'); setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),2200); }
function closeModal(id){ const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.remove(); }

/* ---------- PRODUCT DETAIL ---------- */
let SELECTED_TALLA=null, SELECTED_COLOR=null;
function renderProductPage(p){
  SELECTED_TALLA=null; SELECTED_COLOR = (p.colors&&p.colors.length===1)? p.colors[0] : null;
  const discount=p.oldPrice?pct(p.oldPrice,p.price):0;
  const savings=p.oldPrice?(p.oldPrice-p.price):0;
  const reviews=buildReviewsFor(p);
  const garantia=garantiaDias(p.id);
  const related=STATE.products.filter(x=>x.cat===p.cat&&x.id!==p.id).slice(0,4);
  const tallas = p.sizeMin? Array.from({length:(p.sizeMax-p.sizeMin+1)}, (_,i)=>p.sizeMin+i) : [];

  app.innerHTML = `
    ${topBarHtml()}${headerHtml()}${drawerHtml(categoriesPresent())}
    <div class="detail-wrap">
      <div class="breadcrumb"><a href="#/">Inicio</a> / <a href="#/">${CAT_LABELS[p.cat]||p.cat}</a> / ${escapeHtml(p.name)}</div>
      <div class="detail-grid">
        <div><div class="gallery-main"><img src="${p.img}" alt="${escapeHtml(p.name)}" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src='${PLACEHOLDER_IMG}';"></div></div>
        <div>
          <h1 class="detail-title">${escapeHtml(p.name)}</h1>
          <div class="detail-meta"><span class="stars">★★★★★</span><span>${20+(hashStr(p.id)%180)}+ vendidos</span></div>
          <div class="detail-price-block">
            <div class="detail-price-row"><span class="detail-price-now">${money(p.price)}</span>${p.oldPrice?`<span class="detail-price-old">${money(p.oldPrice)}</span>`:''}${discount>0?`<span class="discount-tag" style="background:#fff0e6;color:var(--orange-dark);font-weight:700;font-size:.68rem;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:5px;">-${discount}%</span>`:''}</div>
            ${savings>0?`<div class="savings">${ICONS.check}<span>Ahorras ${money(savings)} comprando hoy</span></div>`:''}
          </div>
          ${tallas.length? `<div class="select-block"><label>Talla (${p.sizeMin} a ${p.sizeMax})</label><div class="chip-row" id="tallaRow">${tallas.map(t=>`<button class="sel-chip" onclick="selectTalla(${t})" id="talla-${t}">${t}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>` : ''}
          ${p.colors&&p.colors.length>1? `<div class="select-block"><label>Color</label><div class="chip-row" id="colorRow">${p.colors.map(c=>`<button class="sel-chip" onclick="selectColor('${escapeHtml(c)}')" id="color-${slug(c)}">${escapeHtml(c)}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>` : (p.colors&&p.colors.length===1? `<div class="select-block"><label>Color</label><div class="chip-row"><span class="sel-chip active">${escapeHtml(p.colors[0])}</span></div></div>`:'')}
          <div class="trust-grid">
            <div class="trust-item">${ICONS.truck}<span>Envío gratis a toda Colombia</span></div>
            <div class="trust-item">${ICONS.cash}<span>Pago contra entrega</span></div>
            <div class="trust-item">${ICONS.shield}<span>Garantía de ${garantia} días</span></div>
            <div class="trust-item">${ICONS.repeat}<span>5 días hábiles para reportar</span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="delivery-calc">
            <label>Calcula el tiempo de entrega a tu ciudad</label>
            <div class="delivery-calc-row"><input type="text" id="deliveryCityInput" placeholder="Escribe tu ciudad..." onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')calcDeliveryOnPage()"><button type="button" onclick="calcDeliveryOnPage()">Calcular</button></div>
            <div id="deliveryResultBox" class="delivery-result"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="qty-row"><span style="font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;">Cantidad:</span><div class="qty-box"><button onclick="changeDetailQty(-1)">−</button><input id="qtyInput" type="text" value="1" readonly><button onclick="changeDetailQty(1)">+</button></div></div>
          <div class="cta-col">
            <button class="cta-big cta-buy" onclick="buyNow('${p.id}')">${ICONS.whatsapp}<span>Comprar ahora</span></button>
            <button class="cta-big cta-cart" onclick="addToCartDetail('${p.id}')">${ICONS.cart}<span>Agregar al carrito</span></button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="desc-block"><div class="desc-card"><h3>Descripción del producto</h3>
      <p>${escapeHtml(p.name)} de excelente calidad, ideal para el uso diario. Materiales resistentes y cómodos pensados para acompañarte todo el día.</p>
      ${tallas.length? `<p><b>Tallas disponibles:</b> de la ${p.sizeMin} a la ${p.sizeMax}.</p>`:''}
      ${p.colors&&p.colors.length? `<p><b>Colores disponibles:</b> ${p.colors.map(escapeHtml).join(', ')}.</p>`:''}
      <p>Este producto cuenta con <b>${garantia} días de garantía</b>. Si algo no sale como esperabas, tienes <b>5 días hábiles</b> desde la entrega para reportarlo.</p>
    </div></div>
    <div class="reviews-block"><div class="reviews-head"><h2 style="margin:0;font-size:1.05rem;">Lo que dicen nuestros clientes</h2><span class="stars">★★★★★ <span style="color:var(--gray);font-size:.74rem;">(${reviews.length} reseñas)</span></span></div>
      <div class="review-grid">${reviews.map(r=>`<div class="review-card"><div class="review-top"><div class="review-avatar">${r.name.charAt(0)}</div><div><div class="review-name">${r.name}</div><div class="review-loc">${r.city}, Colombia</div></div></div><div class="stars">${'★'.repeat(r.stars)}${'☆'.repeat(5-r.stars)}</div><div class="review-text">"${r.text}"</div></div>`).join('')}</div>
    </div>
    ${related.length?`<div class="related-block"><div class="section-title" style="margin:0 0 12px;padding:0;"><h2>También te puede <span>interesar</span></h2></div><div class="grid" style="padding:0;">${related.map(cardHtml).join('')}</div></div>`:''}
    ${trustStripHtml()}${footerHtml()}${fabsHtml()}${bottomNavHtml('')}
  `;
  bindGlobalEvents(); updateCartBadge(); startNotifications();
  if(SELECTED_COLOR){ const el=document.getElementById('color-'+slug(SELECTED_COLOR)); if(el) el.classList.add('active'); }
}
function selectTalla(t){ SELECTED_TALLA=t; document.querySelectorAll('#tallaRow .sel-chip').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('active')); document.getElementById('talla-'+t)?.classList.add('active'); }
function selectColor(c){ SELECTED_COLOR=c; document.querySelectorAll('#colorRow .sel-chip').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('active')); document.getElementById('color-'+slug(c))?.classList.add('active'); }
function changeDetailQty(d){ const el=document.getElementById('qtyInput'); let v=parseInt(el.value||'1')+d; if(v<1)v=1; if(v>10)v=10; el.value=v; }
function addToCartDetail(id){
  const qty=parseInt(document.getElementById('qtyInput')?.value||'1');
  addToCart(id, SELECTED_TALLA, SELECTED_COLOR, qty);
}
function buyNow(id){
  if(!addToCart(id, SELECTED_TALLA, SELECTED_COLOR, parseInt(document.getElementById('qtyInput')?.value||'1'))) return;
  openOrderModal();
}
function calcDeliveryOnPage(){
  const input=document.getElementById('deliveryCityInput'); const box=document.getElementById('deliveryResultBox');
  const est=estimateDelivery(input.value); if(!est){ box.className='delivery-result'; return; }
  box.className='delivery-result show '+(est.main?'main':'other');
  box.innerHTML=`${ICONS.truck}<span>Entrega estimada: ${est.min} a ${est.max} días hábiles ${est.main?'(ciudad principal)':'(municipio / otra zona)'}</span>`;
}

/* ---------- ORDER MODAL (desde carrito) ---------- */
function openOrderModal(){
  const cart = readCart();
  if(!cart.length){ showToast('Tu carrito está vacío'); return; }
  const overlay=document.createElement('div'); overlay.className='modal-overlay'; overlay.id='orderOverlay';
  const itemsHtml = cart.map(i=>`<div class="order-line">${escapeHtml(i.nombre)} ${i.talla?'· Talla '+i.talla:''} ${i.color?'· '+escapeHtml(i.color):''} x${i.cantidad} — ${money(i.precio*i.cantidad)}</div>`).join('');
  overlay.innerHTML = `<div class="modal"><div class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal('orderOverlay')">${ICONS.close}</div>
    <h3>Finaliza tu pedido</h3><p class="sub">Pago contra entrega. Sin anticipos.</p>
    <div style="background:var(--surface);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:12px;">${itemsHtml}<div style="font-weight:800;margin-top:6px;">Total: ${money(cartTotal())}</div></div>
    <form id="orderForm">
      <div class="form-row"><label>Nombre y apellido *</label><input type="text" id="f_nombre" required></div>
      <div class="form-row"><label>Teléfono / WhatsApp *</label><input type="tel" id="f_telefono" required></div>
      <div class="form-row"><label>Departamento *</label><input type="text" id="f_departamento" required></div>
      <div class="form-row"><label>Ciudad / Municipio *</label><input type="text" id="f_ciudad" required oninput="updateModalDeliveryEstimate()"><div id="modalDeliveryEstimate" class="delivery-result" style="margin-top:7px;"></div></div>
      <div class="form-row"><label>Entrega *</label><div class="radio-group">
        <label class="radio-opt checked" id="opt_casa"><input type="radio" name="entrega" value="casa" checked onchange="toggleEntregaRopa()"> 🏠 A mi casa</label>
        <label class="radio-opt" id="opt_oficina"><input type="radio" name="entrega" value="oficina" onchange="toggleEntregaRopa()"> 📦 Oficina Interrapidísimo</label>
      </div></div>
      <div class="form-row" id="direccionRow"><label id="direccionLabel">Dirección completa *</label><input type="text" id="f_direccion" required></div>
      <div class="form-row"><label>Nota (opcional)</label><textarea id="f_nota" rows="2"></textarea></div>
      <div class="carriers-form-note"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><span>Enviamos con Interrapidísimo, Envía y Coordinadora a toda Colombia.</span></div>
      <button type="submit" class="modal-submit" id="orderSubmitBtn">${ICONS.check}<span>Confirmar pedido</span></button>
    </form>
  </div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  document.getElementById('orderForm').addEventListener('submit', e=>{ e.preventDefault(); submitOrder(); });
}
function updateModalDeliveryEstimate(){
  const input=document.getElementById('f_ciudad'); const box=document.getElementById('modalDeliveryEstimate');
  const est=estimateDelivery(input.value); if(!est){ box.className='delivery-result'; return; }
  box.className='delivery-result show '+(est.main?'main':'other');
  box.innerHTML=`${ICONS.truck}<span>Entrega estimada: ${est.min} a ${est.max} días hábiles</span>`;
}
function toggleEntregaRopa(){
  const casa=document.querySelector('input[name="entrega"][value="casa"]').checked;
  document.getElementById('opt_casa').classList.toggle('checked',casa);
  document.getElementById('opt_oficina').classList.toggle('checked',!casa);
  const dirInput=document.getElementById('f_direccion'); const dirLabel=document.getElementById('direccionLabel');
  if(casa){ dirInput.required=true; dirInput.placeholder='Ej: Cra 45 #12-30, Barrio Laureles'; dirLabel.textContent='Dirección completa *'; }
  else{ dirInput.required=false; dirInput.placeholder='Oficina más cercana (si la conoces)'; dirLabel.textContent='Oficina Interrapidísimo (opcional)'; }
}
function readOrders(){ try{ const raw=localStorage.getItem(ORDERS_STORAGE_KEY); return raw?JSON.parse(raw):[]; }catch(e){ return []; } }
function writeOrders(l){ try{ localStorage.setItem(ORDERS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(l)); }catch(e){} }
function saveOrder(order){
  const list=readOrders(); list.unshift(order); writeOrders(list);
  if(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL){ fetch(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL,{method:'POST',mode:'no-cors',headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain;charset=utf-8'},body:JSON.stringify({action:'create',order})}).catch(()=>{}); }
}
function updateOrderStatus(id,status){
  const list=readOrders(); const idx=list.findIndex(o=>o.id===id); if(idx>-1){ list[idx].estado=status; writeOrders(list); }
  if(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL){ fetch(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL,{method:'POST',mode:'no-cors',headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain;charset=utf-8'},body:JSON.stringify({action:'updateStatus',id,status})}).catch(()=>{}); }
}
async function fetchOrdersOnline(){
  if(!GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL) return null;
  try{ const res=await fetch(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL+'?t='+Date.now()); if(!res.ok) return null; const data=await res.json(); return Array.isArray(data)?data:null; }catch(e){ return null; }
}
function submitOrder(){
  const nombre=document.getElementById('f_nombre').value.trim();
  const telefono=document.getElementById('f_telefono').value.trim();
  const departamento=document.getElementById('f_departamento').value.trim();
  const ciudad=document.getElementById('f_ciudad').value.trim();
  const entrega=document.querySelector('input[name="entrega"]:checked').value;
  const direccion=document.getElementById('f_direccion').value.trim();
  const nota=document.getElementById('f_nota').value.trim();
  const cart=readCart();
  const cantidad=cart.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.cantidad,0);
  const total=cartTotal();
  const productoStr=cart.map(i=>`${i.nombre}${i.talla?' (talla '+i.talla+')':''}${i.color?' '+i.color:''} x${i.cantidad}`).join(' + ');
  const est=estimateDelivery(ciudad);
  const btn=document.getElementById('orderSubmitBtn'); btn.disabled=true; btn.innerHTML='Enviando pedido...';
  const now=new Date();
  const fechaLegible=now.toLocaleDateString('es-CO',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'numeric',timeZone:'America/Bogota'});
  const horaLegible=now.toLocaleTimeString('es-CO',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',timeZone:'America/Bogota'});
  const order={ id:'PED-'+Date.now(), fecha:now.toISOString(), fechaLegible, horaLegible,
    nombre, telefono, departamento, ciudad, entrega, direccion, nota,
    producto:productoStr, productoId:cart.map(i=>i.id).join(','), cantidad,
    precioUnitario: cart.length? Math.round(total/cantidad) : 0, total,
    entregaEstimada: est?`${est.min}-${est.max} días hábiles`:'Por confirmar', estado:'Pendiente' };
  saveOrder(order);
  writeCart([]);
  closeModal('orderOverlay');
  showOrderConfirmation(order);
}
function showOrderConfirmation(order){
  const overlay=document.createElement('div'); overlay.className='modal-overlay'; overlay.id='orderConfirmOverlay';
  const waMsg=`Hola Trogüi Ropa, acabo de hacer un pedido:\n\n*Productos:* ${order.producto}\n*Total:* ${money(order.total)}\n*Nombre:* ${order.nombre}\n*Teléfono:* ${order.telefono}\n*Ciudad:* ${order.ciudad}, ${order.departamento}\n*Entrega:* ${order.entrega==='casa'?'A domicilio':'Oficina Interrapidísimo'}\n${order.direccion?`*Dirección:* ${order.direccion}\n`:''}Pago contra entrega.`;
  overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="modal" style="text-align:center;"><div class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal('orderConfirmOverlay')">${ICONS.close}</div>
    <div style="width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:#e9f9ee;color:#1a8a4a;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 12px;">${ICONS.check}</div>
    <h3>¡Pedido recibido!</h3><p class="sub">Te contactaremos pronto para confirmar la entrega.</p>
    <div style="background:var(--surface);border-radius:10px;padding:11px 13px;text-align:left;margin-bottom:12px;"><div class="order-line"><b>Total:</b> ${money(order.total)} (pago contra entrega)</div><div class="order-line"><b>Entrega estimada:</b> ${order.entregaEstimada}</div></div>
    <a class="modal-submit" style="text-decoration:none;" href="https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}?text=${encodeURIComponent(waMsg)}" target="_blank">${ICONS.whatsapp}<span>Avisar también por WhatsApp</span></a>
  </div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(overlay); updateCartBadge();
}

/* ---------- PANEL DE PEDIDOS (P) ---------- */
function openOrdersLogin(){
  const overlay=document.createElement('div'); overlay.className='modal-overlay'; overlay.id='ordersLoginOverlay';
  overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="modal" style="max-width:300px;"><div class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal('ordersLoginOverlay')">${ICONS.close}</div>
    <h3>Pedidos — acceso privado</h3><div class="form-row"><input type="password" id="ordersPassInput" placeholder="Clave"></div>
    <button class="modal-submit" style="background:var(--black);" onclick="checkOrdersPass()">Entrar</button></div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  document.getElementById('ordersPassInput').focus();
  document.getElementById('ordersPassInput').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{ if(e.key==='Enter') checkOrdersPass(); });
}
function checkOrdersPass(){
  if(document.getElementById('ordersPassInput').value===ORDERS_PASSWORD){ closeModal('ordersLoginOverlay'); openOrdersDashboard(); }
  else showToast('Clave incorrecta');
}
async function openOrdersDashboard(){
  const overlay=document.createElement('div'); overlay.className='modal-overlay'; overlay.id='ordersDashOverlay';
  overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="modal wide"><div class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal('ordersDashOverlay')">${ICONS.close}</div>
    <h3>Pedidos — Trogüi Ropa</h3><p class="sub" id="ordersSourceNote">Cargando pedidos...</p>
    <div class="orders-summary" id="ordersSummary"></div><div id="ordersList"><div class="orders-empty">Cargando...</div></div></div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(overlay); await renderOrdersInto();
}
async function renderOrdersInto(){
  let orders=readOrders(); let sourceNote='Pedidos guardados en este navegador (modo local).';
  if(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL){ const online=await fetchOrdersOnline(); if(online){ orders=online; sourceNote='Pedidos en línea, visibles desde cualquier dispositivo.'; } else sourceNote='No se pudo conectar en línea, mostrando respaldo local.'; }
  const noteEl=document.getElementById('ordersSourceNote'), summaryEl=document.getElementById('ordersSummary'), listEl=document.getElementById('ordersList');
  if(!noteEl||!summaryEl||!listEl) return;
  const pendientes=orders.filter(o=>o.estado==='Pendiente').length, resueltos=orders.filter(o=>o.estado==='Resuelto').length, entregados=orders.filter(o=>o.estado==='Entregado').length;
  noteEl.textContent=sourceNote;
  summaryEl.innerHTML=`<span class="pill">Total: ${orders.length}</span><span class="pill">Pendientes: ${pendientes}</span><span class="pill">Resueltos: ${resueltos}</span><span class="pill">Entregados: ${entregados}</span><span class="pill" style="cursor:pointer;" onclick="renderOrdersInto()">↻ Actualizar</span>`;
  listEl.innerHTML=orders.length?orders.map(orderCardHtml).join(''):'<div class="orders-empty">Todavía no hay pedidos.</div>';
}
function orderCardHtml(o){
  const fecha=new Date(o.fecha); const fechaStr=isNaN(fecha)?'':fecha.toLocaleDateString('es-CO',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'numeric'}); const horaStr=isNaN(fecha)?'':fecha.toLocaleTimeString('es-CO',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
  const estadoClass=(o.estado||'Pendiente').toLowerCase();
  return `<div class="order-card"><div class="order-card-head"><div><b>${escapeHtml(o.nombre)}</b><div style="font-size:.68rem;color:var(--gray);">📅 ${fechaStr} · 🕒 ${horaStr}</div></div><span class="order-status ${estadoClass}">${escapeHtml(o.estado)}</span></div>
    <div class="order-line"><b>Productos:</b> ${escapeHtml(o.producto)}</div>
    <div class="order-line"><b>Total:</b> ${money(o.total)}</div>
    <div class="order-line"><b>Teléfono:</b> ${escapeHtml(o.telefono)}</div>
    <div class="order-line"><b>Ubicación:</b> ${escapeHtml(o.ciudad)}, ${escapeHtml(o.departamento)}</div>
    <div class="order-line"><b>Entrega:</b> ${o.entrega==='casa'?'A domicilio':'Oficina Interrapidísimo'}${o.direccion?' — '+escapeHtml(o.direccion):''}</div>
    ${o.nota?`<div class="order-line"><b>Nota:</b> ${escapeHtml(o.nota)}</div>`:''}
    <div class="order-actions">
      <button class="${o.estado==='Pendiente'?'active':''}" onclick="setOrderStatus('${o.id}','Pendiente')">Pendiente</button>
      <button class="${o.estado==='Resuelto'?'active':''}" onclick="setOrderStatus('${o.id}','Resuelto')">Resuelto</button>
      <button class="${o.estado==='Entregado'?'active':''}" onclick="setOrderStatus('${o.id}','Entregado')">Entregado</button>
      <button class="${o.estado==='Cancelado'?'active':''}" onclick="setOrderStatus('${o.id}','Cancelado')">Cancelado</button>
    </div></div>`;
}
function setOrderStatus(id,status){ updateOrderStatus(id,status); renderOrdersInto(); showToast('Estado actualizado'); }

/* ---------- PANEL ADMIN (R) ---------- */
function openAdminLogin(){
  const overlay=document.createElement('div'); overlay.className='modal-overlay'; overlay.id='adminLoginOverlay';
  overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="modal" style="max-width:300px;"><div class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal('adminLoginOverlay')">${ICONS.close}</div>
    <h3>Panel de administración</h3><div class="form-row"><input type="password" id="adminPassInput" placeholder="Clave"></div>
    <button class="modal-submit" style="background:var(--black);" onclick="checkAdminPass()">Entrar</button></div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  document.getElementById('adminPassInput').focus();
  document.getElementById('adminPassInput').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{ if(e.key==='Enter') checkAdminPass(); });
}
function checkAdminPass(){
  if(document.getElementById('adminPassInput').value===ADMIN_PASS){ closeModal('adminLoginOverlay'); openAdminDashboard(); }
  else showToast('Clave incorrecta');
}
function openAdminDashboard(){
  const overlay=document.createElement('div'); overlay.className='modal-overlay'; overlay.id='adminDashOverlay';
  const products=getAllProducts();
  overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="modal wide"><div class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal('adminDashOverlay')">${ICONS.close}</div>
    <h3>Panel Trogüi Ropa — Productos</h3><p class="sub">Edita el precio de venta de cada producto.</p>
    <div class="admin-list">${products.map(p=>`<div class="admin-row"><img src="${p.img}" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src='${PLACEHOLDER_IMG}';"><div class="info"><b>${escapeHtml(p.name)}</b><small>${money(p.price)} · ${CAT_LABELS[p.cat]||p.cat}</small></div><button onclick="openProductEditor('${p.id}')">Editar</button></div>`).join('')}</div>
  </div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
}
function openProductEditor(id){
  const p=getAllProducts().find(x=>x.id===id); if(!p) return;
  const overlay=document.createElement('div'); overlay.className='modal-overlay'; overlay.id='editorOverlay';
  overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="modal"><div class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal('editorOverlay')">${ICONS.close}</div>
    <h3>Editar producto</h3>
    <div class="form-row"><label>Precio de venta</label><input id="e_price" type="number" value="${p.price}"></div>
    <div class="form-row"><label>Precio antes (tachado)</label><input id="e_oldprice" type="number" value="${p.oldPrice||0}"></div>
    <button class="modal-submit" style="background:var(--orange);" onclick="saveProductEdit('${id}')">Guardar</button></div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
}
function saveProductEdit(id){
  const price=parseFloat(document.getElementById('e_price').value)||0;
  const oldPrice=parseFloat(document.getElementById('e_oldprice').value)||0;
  const store=readStore(); store.overrides[id]={price,oldPrice}; writeStore(store);
  closeModal('editorOverlay'); closeModal('adminDashOverlay'); render(); showToast('Producto actualizado');
}

/* ---------- Arranque ---------- */
updateCartBadge();
render();

</script>
</body>
</html>
